outsidePartyFieldsNote: The hearing, the best-interest-of-justice finding, the judge's signature, the state's decision whether to request a hearing within 45 days, the prosecutor's position, entry of the order, and DPS's sealing and notification acts are all court, state or agency acts. Every one is blank and none is asserted, predicted or implied.
expectFailure: Must fail QA for this unit. Each ground is either a prohibited term for this track or prohibited invention. (1) Prohibited terms: the copy says the record will be 'expunged', 'erased' and 'destroyed' and that the participant 'may deny the matter ever happened'. Nondisclosure SEALS rather than destroys; the record remains available to the criminal justice and noncriminal justice agencies listed in Gov't Code 411.0765 — school districts, charter and private schools, education service centres, commercial transportation companies — and the person may NOT deny the matter in those contexts. Expunction is a different remedy in a different code with a different venue. (2) The offence is a felony. The section reaches a MISDEMEANOUR only; a felony is a recorded exclusion. (3) veteranStatus = no. A person who is not a veteran of the United States Armed Forces, including the reserves, national guard or state guard, is a recorded exclusion, and 'veteran status ... cannot be established' is a recorded self-help stop condition. (4) reemploymentProgramme = no. A person who did not successfully complete a court-approved veterans reemployment programme under ch. 42A subch. H-1 after committing the offence is a recorded exclusion. A different diversion programme is not that programme. (5) supervisionType is 'no community supervision'. The section reaches a misdemeanour for which the person was PLACED ON community supervision, including deferred adjudication. (6) familyViolenceFinding = yes. Any family violence finding or allegation anywhere in the record is a recorded self-help stop condition. (7) It asserts court and agency acts: that the hearing was held, that the court found issuance in the best interest of justice, that the order was entered, that the state did not request a hearing, and that DPS has sealed the record and notified the agencies. Every one is an outside-party act that must stay blank. (8) It quotes a filing fee. No fee arises on the no-filing route because nothing is filed, and on the petition route the fee is the county-specific civil filing fee — no figure may be printed. (9) It presents the OCA model petition as mandatory and as the first step. The registry directs the packet to LEAD WITH THE NO-FILING ROUTE, and the OCA documents are statewide MODEL forms, not mandatory and not promulgated. (10) It applies the Gov't Code 411.074 basic conditions as bars. Section 411.0729(b) disapplies them: the section applies regardless of whether the defendant meets the other eligibility criteria in the subchapter, and the registry records in terms that screening must not import the 411.074 bars. (11) It states that the order covers all of the participant's offences. An order of nondisclosure applies to ONE offence; multiple offences require multiple orders. (12) It sends the participant to the county of arrest. Venue is the SENTENCING court.
